result_summary.title: Analytics Dashboard API Returning Empty Responses
result_summary.description: We are observing that the Analytics Dashboard API endpoints are returning empty responses for a subset of requests in the ANZ production region. This is impacting approximately 900 users who are seeing blank widgets or failed data loads. The issue appears intermittent but frequent enough to disrupt daily reporting for our teams.
